description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340013674102 BRACKET,MOUNTING: Line 0001 Qty 81 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0081 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 12. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 09YN3 65217-09007-046; 2B834 65217-09007-046; 54878 65217-09007-046; 78286 65217-09007-046. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
